  | /etc/sudoers.d/README:# This will cause sudo to read and parse any files in the /etc/sudoers.d
  | /etc/sudoers.d/README:# directory that do not end in '~' or contain a '.' character, if it
  | /etc/sudoers.d/README:# exists. It is not an error if the directory does not exist.
  | /etc/sudoers.d/README:#
  | /etc/sudoers.d/README:# Note also, that because sudoers contents can vary widely, no attempt is

  | free

  | /etc/sudoers.d/README:# #includedir. That means that the sudo versions in Debian bullseye (11)
